provenance.statement: These tool names were transcribed on 2026-09-03 from a third-party published inventory dated 2026-09-02 (likeMdl/binance-ai-risk-trader, docs/binance-agent-os-tools.md), which states that it captured them from a live OAuth session against https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic. They were not captured from our own session: Deltr has never reached the official endpoint from this machine, where agent.binance.com does not resolve. The claim is name compatibility with a published inventory, never verification against Binance.
